text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Visiting U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry tells Turkish officials that Washington is about to strike Iraq.
- Turkey to manufacture its first oil platform.
- Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas free two Turkish soldiers they had been holding in northern Iraq for more than a year.
- Then deputy prime minister Murat Karayalcin says he was unaware of order issued in 1993 to bug mobile telephones.
- Baghdad-backed Iraqi Kurdish leader Massoud Barzani to visit Turkish border town this week to discuss border security with Turkish officials.
- Large firms take big slice of state subsidies originally aimed at boosting small companies' exports and investments.
- Government bid to allow Turkish workers in Germany to import cars tax free will help Germany's economy more than Turkey's.
- PKK form unit made up solely of liberal Moslem Alevis to stir up religious differences in central province of Sivas.
